verify.note: Narrowed 2026-10-06 by LIVE-753: ADR-1709 puts PAID memberships at Business (supersedes ADR-1415). What survives of this row is that a free Space keeps a free-to-join tier: the write asks the payments gate only when a tier carries a price.

append.detail: ── SUPERSEDED IN PART 2026-10-06 by ADR-1709 (LIVE-753). Paid memberships sit at Business again (space_memberships minEntitlement business, plus space_payments), checked outside the grace window. The free Space keeps one free-to-join tier, which is the half of this row that still holds, so the probe was narrowed to that consequence.
